stem:
Sonia views a cone from above and sees a circular profile. She asks whether only a cone can show that circle from a chosen viewpoint.

Which claim is correct?

options.text: Conclude that only the cone works, skipping that the same circular profile can come from more than one solid.
Say that the circular profile chooses the above viewpoint on the cone, instead of the viewpoint shaping the profile.
A cone can show a circle from above, but more than one solid can fit that same circular profile from a chosen viewpoint.
Use the same profile question to compute the cone's volume, beyond identifying possible profiles.

teacher.key_rationale: Viewpoint shapes the profile; a circle from above fits a cone and other solids (e.g. cylinder). A omits multi-solid possibility. B reverses. D leaves the profile hinge.
